services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a beautiful early morning and watch the sun rise above Diamond Head Crater and the stunning island of Oahu as we look for amazing wildlife like Hawaiian green sea turtles and spinner dolphins. Many people spend the first few days of their trip waking up before the sun, why not make the best of it! We went on the sunrise whale watching cruise in February 2024, Forrest and his crew were knowledgeable giving us facts about the local marine life. We saw a group of sleeping dolphins, flying fish and sea turtles. We saw whales blowing and then their tails as the dove back down. services.name: Half Day Charter
services.desc: Welcome aboard Love Well, your private floating sanctuary on the stunning waters of Oahu. Whether you’re dreaming of snorkeling with sea turtles, catching a golden Waikiki sunset, or watching fireworks light up the skyline, we have a curated experience just for you. Slip into crystal-clear waters and explore vibrant reefs teeming with marine life. Swim alongside Hawaiian green sea turtles, colorful reef fish, and on some days even spot spinner dolphins gliding through the waves. Nature always amazes, and every tour offers its own kind of magic. Sail into the golden hour on the calm evening seas. services.name: Whale Watching
services.desc: Every fall, thousands of North Pacific humpback whales embark on one of the longest migrations of any mammal. They swim over 3,000 miles from Alaska and Canada to Hawaii, a journey that takes about four to six weeks. Whales make the trip without feeding; instead, they build up blubber reserves by eating up to 3,000 pounds of krill, herring and small fish per day in their northern feeding grounds. Once they arrive in Hawaii, they use those fat stores to sustain themselves while they mate, give birth and nurse their calves.
